_comment: Per-category PASSED counts (pass + flaky) of a green FULL tier-L run: the FLOOR of the count-drop check. GATE-TRUST-2540 (TR-07): the engine raises each category's baseline to its passed count in the newest GREEN FULL tier-L run of the results directories (release gates and nightly, at most GATE_BASELINE_REF_DAYS = 30 days old; release_gate.py reference_baseline()), so this file no longer needs a hand refresh after each release; refresh it only to lift the floor. A category fails when its passed count is below its threshold of the baseline: 'thresholds' here, else the engine's DEFAULT_DROP_THRESHOLDS (backend / preview / dev 0.90, pixel / fixture 0.85), else GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD (default 0.70); GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD and GATE_DROP_THRESHOLD_<CATEGORY> override. --allow-count-drop "<reason>" waives the check (the waived run then becomes the new reference). Only tier L has a baseline; a diff-selection gate never checks the ratio (it prints 'selection').
source: GATE-TRUST-2540 (2026-11-26): the newest GREEN FULL tier-L run on the runner, the 2.50.0 release gate release/2500-train @ bdf28fc37 (2026-11-24): backend 44902, preview 23818, dev 1126, pixel 390, fixture 28 (its baseline_candidate). The previous values (GATELANES-297, 2026-10-27: preview 14971, backend 17611, pixel 175, dev 935, fixture 15) were a month and 27,000 backend tests behind: a full run could lose 72 percent of the backend and pass (review finding TR-07).
